page_title: ALA 3-1 GRA | Alaves v Granada CF 24/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:4.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Luis Rioja will be replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
87' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is the one who receives a yellow card.
86' 3 - 1 Goal! Antonio Sivera gets a hand on the penalty from Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF), but can't stop it from flying into the top left corner.
86' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

85' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. It's a penalty to Granada CF! Let's see who's going to take it.
84' The cross into the penalty area from Alex Sola (Alaves) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
80' Paco Lopez has decided to make a change. Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) replaces Wilson Manafa.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Shon Weissman (Granada CF) for Oscar Melendo.
80' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
79' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Granada CF.
74' Substitution. Jon Guridi makes his way off the pitch and Ianis Hagi (Alaves) comes on as his replacement.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kike Garcia (Alaves) replaces Samu Omorodion.
72' Wilson Manafa (Granada CF) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
69' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Abderrahmane Rebbach and he is replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).
69' Ander Guevara goes off the pitch and Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) comes on.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
62' Substitution. Alvaro Fernandez is replaced by Antonio Puertas (Granada CF).
62' Here is a change. Gonzalo Villar is going off and Paco Lopez gives the last tactical orders to Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF).
62' That's the end of the game for Lucas Boye, who is replaced by Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF).
61' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
58' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
55' 3 - 0 Samu Omorodion (Alaves) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
54' Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul after Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
52' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Wilson Manafa (Granada CF) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
47' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Shots on target – 1:1.
43' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
42' Jon Guridi (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
40' A lofted cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

38' 2 - 0 Goal! Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Andre Ferreira had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
37' Rafa Marin (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Luis Rioja (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' Luis Rioja (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement.
30' Javi Lopez (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
27' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
24' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
23' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
21' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Rafa Marin (Alaves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
16' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola Rojas and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

11' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Raul Torrent (Granada CF), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the middle of his own goal and behind the goalkeeper.
11' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ander Guevara (Alaves) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ander Guevara (Alaves) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
5' Javi Lopez (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Carlos Neva (Granada CF).
1' The first half has just begun.
Granada CF will kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas will supervise the game today.
